description: List licensed insurers with optional filters and bounded pages (25 by default, at most 200; a page of large records stops early to keep the response small and reports nextOffset). Filter by continent ("africa", "europe", "asia-pacific", "south-america", "north-america"), country slug (e.g. "micronesia"), class slug (e.g. "captive-risk-retention-group", "composite", "funeral-assistance", "general-non-life", "health-medical"), group type slug (e.g. "corporate-parent-captive", "domestic-private", "foreign-multinational", "mutual-cooperative"), parent group slug or verification level. Country filtering fetches only that market's full insurer records; compact returns lean rows instead.

compact.description: true: return each insurer as a lean row (slug, name, country, class, groupSlug, verification) without notes, source text, identifiers or links, so more rows fit in one response. get_insurer returns the full record for any slug.

country.description: Country slug (e.g. "micronesia") or ISO alpha-2 code (e.g. "FM").

group.description: Parent group slug, e.g. "allianz"; list_groups returns them all.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

verification.description: Verification level against the source register.

name: list_insurers

outputSchema.description: A JSON envelope. Successful results carry dataset, version, verified and licence plus the tool’s data; failures carry error, code and retryable.

verified.description: Date the dataset snapshot was verified.

version.description: Dataset version the result was read from.

title: List licensed insurers with filters
